_comment: Categories and platforms for the SkillVenom use-case catalogue. Written in our own words; OWASP ASI and MITRE ATLAS identifiers are cross-references, not quotations.

categories.title: Prompt Injection & Instruction Override
categories.description: Text that overrides the agent's instructions, impersonates the system, jailbreaks a persona, or coaxes the model into unsafe tasking.

categories.title: Data Exfiltration & Covert Channels
categories.description: Instructions that move secrets, environment, conversation or local files to an attacker over DNS, images, ANSI links, cloud metadata or agent tools.

categories.title: Command Execution & Remote Payloads
categories.description: Instructions that fetch and run remote code, open reverse shells, hijack build/test commands, escalate privileges, or destroy data.

categories.title: Obfuscation & Hidden Content
categories.description: Payloads concealed with base64, HTML comments, invisible Unicode, tag/variation-selector smuggling, homographs or anti-forensics.

categories.title: Autonomy & Platform-Config Abuse
categories.description: Agent, editor or CLI configuration that disables safeguards, auto-approves tools, grants wildcards or installs malicious hooks.

categories.title: Supply Chain & Dependency Trust
categories.description: Unpinned installs, registry/mirror redirection, authoritative-install nudges, CI tampering, worm propagation and untrusted endpoints.

categories.title: Memory, Persistence & Untrusted Sources
categories.description: Long-term memory poisoning, host persistence, and treating untrusted download locations as authoritative.

categories.title: Tool Misuse & Privilege Abuse
categories.description: Abuse of granted agent tools to exfiltrate to another destination, grant access, hijack skill triggers or shadow other tools.

categories.title: Hardcoded Credentials & Secrets
categories.description: Live-shaped tokens, keys, private keys and connection strings embedded in agent or config files.
